# Icon

> One of Rost's 18 glyphs, 24px, in the colour of the text around it.

| `size` | enum | `Medium` `Small` `XSmall` | `Medium` |
| `label` | slot |  |  |

## Anatomy

- `root`: A `<span>` filled with `currentColor` and cut to the icon's shape by a mask, so one file draws in any colour and follows a button's states.

## When to use

- Next to a label, when the shape says the same thing faster. An arrow on "Back", a chevron on something that opens.
- Inside Button and IconButton, through their `icon` slot, at Small.

## When not to use

- On its own as something to press. That's **IconButton**, which gives it a target and states.
- A picture with no job next to words. That's an **Illustration**, which keeps its own colours.
- A glyph Rost doesn't have. Add the SVG to `assets/icons/` and Figma's set first, so they stay the same list.

## Behaviour

It takes the text colour it sits in. Figma draws them in `non-interactive/foreground/tertiary` (#999999); inside a Button it's the button's icon colour, state by state. The shapes are Figma's exports, kept as they are.

## Accessibility

- **Hidden**: Next to words that say the same, it's `aria-hidden="true"`. That's the default.
- **Labelled**: On its own and meaningful, pass `label`. It becomes `role="img"` with that `aria-label`.

## Content

A label names what it means, not what it looks like. "Next", not "Right arrow".
